'''Mark Davis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 14th, 0 (−29), 0–1 at [[2001 Origins Constructed (6 July)]] on 6 July 2001, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2602">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1d2602/ origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 9 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1d2602/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
